[[File:Northshire River.png|thumb|The falls as seen near [[Northshire Abbey]].]]
'''Northshire River''' flows from the [[Crystal Falls]] in [[Northwind]], through [[Northshire Valley]], and eventually empties its waters into [[Crystal Lake]] in [[Elwynn Forest]].

==Notes and trivia==
* Although not displayed in the overworld, the subzone is found in the ''World of Warcraft'' files.
* Before [[patch 1.18.0]], the source of the river in the mountains was only visible while on a [[flight path]] between [[Stormwind City]] and [[Ironforge]], and thus was inaccessible to players of the [[Horde]] faction by normal means.
